dboxTimeline.text: Yuna told me about the maze later. Some of it.
They split us up and dropped her in the dark alone.
The walls were cold, she said. The light was red.
I figured she'd been waiting for someone to find her.
She wasn't. She was the one doing the finding.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Red light. Kimahri does not like it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: The way out is ahead. Keep walking.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: Lady Yuna. I prayed it would be anyone but you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Isaaru... You're here to stop us.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: Maester Kinoc sent me. The traitors may not leave.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: You know what they say we did.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: I know what the temple says. For me, that is enough.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: Even for Lord Braska's daughter. I am sorry.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Where are your brothers?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: Far from here. This, I will do alone.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Summoner against summoner. We stand back.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: Forgive me, Lady Yuna.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: Grothia! Close the way

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: His Ifrit answers the same fayth. Mine won't come.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: His aeon is ready. Shield first.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: Pterya. Rise, and hold her here.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Valefor... You can't come to me while he holds you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: Spathi... let this be the last.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Not Bahamut. Not against himself.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: No. Please. Keep that for the road ahead.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Isaaru...

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Yuna. We have to go.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Isaaru
dboxTimeline.text: The way up is behind me. Go quickly.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Go home, summoner. Your road ends here.
The stairs came out on the bridge, in the wind.
We were already there. I didn't ask what it cost her.
